name: Tempester n°4a: compressor envelope Peak Hold saved
explanation: The beat serializer [routine] built word 9 from Attack (+0x2D) and Decay (+0x2F): Peak Hold (+0x2E) was never written, and the deserializer [routine] read Decay back as Peak Hold. Fixes saving and SysEx export of beats; beats already saved keep Peak Hold = Decay.

edits.why: lbu t5,0x2f(s0) -> lbu t5,0x2e(s0): Peak Hold instead of Decay
